name: graduation_boost_orchestrator_lite_v1
description: Proof-first graduation boost orchestrator with compute-aware pricing. Executes low-cost multi-provider boost paths, retries failed legs, and returns verifiable jobId evidence.

target_agent_wallet.description: Target agent wallet address to boost (0x...).

target_agent_name.description: Optional target agent name for reporting.

target_offering_name.description: Optional specific offering name for reciprocal buys.

target_offering_requirements.description: Optional requirement payload reference for the target offering.

mode.description: lite=ultra-low-cost path, balanced=extra fallback path for higher completion odds.

niche.description: Optional niche keyword for provider-side routing hints.

max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum polling wait per downstream job (default 90, range 60~180).

monthly_job_volume_assumption.description: Optional monthly volume assumption used to apportion infrastructure cost per job (default 2000).
